Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

How We Determine What We Pay
As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

Job Applicant Privacy Policy
This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“Legion”, “we”, “us” and “our”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

• 
Types of Personal Information We Handle

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

• Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.

• Professional or employment-related information, including:

• Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.

• Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships

• Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.

• Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.

• Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.

• 
How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.

• 
With Whom We Share Personal Information

We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):

• Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.

• Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.

• Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.

• Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.

• Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.

• How to Contact Us About this Policy – If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion.co.

At Varicent, we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the 2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, and G2. Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

• Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.

• Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.

• Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.

• Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

Important: This role is listed as a 12 month contract.

Summary of the Role and Team 

As a Technical Analyst I, you will join Varicent's Technical Support team, a customer-facing organization responsible for helping customers successfully use and adopt Varicent's SaaS and on-premises solutions. 

Working closely with customers, Product, Engineering, and internal support teams, you will investigate technical issues, provide timely resolutions, and help customers maximize the value of their Varicent solutions. This role offers exposure to a broad range of technologies and is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, troubleshooting, and delivering exceptional customer experiences. 

What You Will Be Doing 

• Investigate and resolve technical issues by analyzing customer-reported problems, reviewing logs, gathering diagnostic information, and reproducing issues 

• Communicate clearly with customers regarding issue status, troubleshooting steps, resolution plans, and next actions 

• Maintain accurate case documentation and customer records within CRM and support systems 

• Utilize support tools, knowledge resources, and established processes to manage cases efficiently 

• Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and internal teams to escalate issues and support resolution efforts 

• Share product knowledge and best practices that help customers improve solution utilization and business outcomes 

• Contribute to service-level objectives by supporting key performance metrics such as response times, resolution targets, and quality standards 

• Participate in on-call and weekend support rotations as required 

What You Bring 

• 1+ years of experience supporting software applications, SaaS platforms, or customer-facing technical environments 

• Knowledge of relational databases and SQL fundamentals 

• Familiarity with client-server architecture and web-based application troubleshooting 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate technical issues systematically 

• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 

• Experience documenting troubleshooting activities, findings, and resolutions 

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering a high-quality customer experience 

Success Outcomes 

First 30 Days 

• Complete onboarding and develop a working understanding of Varicent products, support processes, and troubleshooting methodologies 

• Become familiar with support tools, knowledge resources, escalation paths, and case management practices 

• Begin contributing to customer cases while demonstrating strong documentation and communication skills 

Within 60 Days 

• Resolve common customer issues across Varicent products with guidance from peers and senior team members 

• Demonstrate proficiency using support tools and established troubleshooting processes 

• Maintain accurate customer communications and case records while meeting team quality standards 

Within 90 Days 

• Independently manage a broad range of customer support issues and investigations 

• Resolve issues within expected service levels while effectively collaborating with internal stakeholders when escalation is required 

• Demonstrate the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, identify root causes, and communicate resolutions effectively 

• Consistently contribute to customer satisfaction, support quality, and operational performance objectives 

For this role, the estimated annual base salary range is between 127,000.00 - 166,700.00 RON. In addition to base salary, our compensation package may include bonuses, commissions for eligible sales roles, and a comprehensive benefits package. The actual base salary will vary based on factors including individual qualifications and market data, as objectively assessed during the interview process. 

This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making. 

Overview of Benefits: 

• Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, tailored to your local needs 

• Time Off — PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most 

• Volunteer Days — Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you 

• Ignite Days — Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning 

• Financial — Compensation that reflects your market and your value 

• Tuition Assistance — Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development 

• Flexibility — Work where you thrive — remote and hybrid options available across most regions 

Varicent is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process please email accomodations@varicent.com

Varicent is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. As a Junior Designer, you will be an integral part of our creative team, contributing to a variety of projects across digital and print media. You will work closely with senior designers, marketing professionals, and other team members to create visually compelling designs that align with our brandâs vision and goals. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career designer looking to grow and develop their skills in a supportive and innovative environment.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Design Your Future With Us. Creativity lives here. We celebrate craftsmanship, design, and inspired living. Whether you are in marketing, tech, or logistics, your voice and vision matter. We showcase employee spaces, share design stories, and promote growth through a culture of flexibility, storytelling, and opportunity. From onboarding to day-to-day, we help you bring your style to life.

Reports to: Director of Engineering 

Location: Remote, United States

\n

About the Role
Our retail platform is scaling across multiple brands and needs a senior engineer who can own a service area end-to-end â setting technical direction, writing production code daily, and raising the bar for the developers around you. As Software Engineer (Team Lead), you will serve as the technical owner for a core area of our retail service cloud, designing approaches, contributing code, and mentoring engineers while driving the roadmap from legacy replacement through new feature delivery.

In your first 6â12 months, success means you have shipped meaningful improvements to the platform, replaced targeted legacy services, and established clear technical standards that the team follows without prompting.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

• Serve as technical owner for your area or service within the retail service cloud, setting architecture direction and maintaining quality standards

• Design, build, and ship features â reading and writing code daily alongside the team

• Identify and resolve technical challenges across the stack, from profiling and refactoring to scaling the platform

• Replace legacy code and services with modern, maintainable solutions and optimize the overall stack

• Build frameworks and reusable patterns for upcoming projects across the portfolio

• Plan and communicate product roadmaps, triage sprint tickets, and push back on requests when technical tradeoffs demand it

• Mentor junior engineers through code review, pairing, and hands-on problem solving

• Help build the team by driving developer productivity and contributing to hiring decisions

Required Qualifications

• Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node.js

• Proficiency / production experience with API Gateway, AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB.

• Comfortable with IAM and CloudWatch for debugging + least-privilege design

• Experience with Python and Django or comparable server-side frameworks

• Track record of owning a product or service area technically â architecture decisions, code quality, and delivery outcomes

• Demonstrated ability to mentor and elevate other engineers while remaining a significant individual contributor

• Experience replacing or modernizing legacy systems in a production environment

• Comfort triaging competing priorities, planning sprints, and communicating technical details to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong opinions on code quality and engineering best practices, held loosely enough to find the best solution collaboratively

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with retail, e-commerce, or multi-brand platform environments

• Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and microservices patterns

• Prior experience in a technical lead role on a small, high-output team

Why Join 
The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

• Cross-Functional Impact: Your technical decisions will shape services that power multiple brands across the portfolio â the scope of your work is visible and immediate.

• Skill Building: Work alongside senior engineers who will challenge your thinking, with daily exposure to modern frameworks, platform-scale problems, and AI-augmented tooling.

• End-to-End Ownership: Own your service area from architecture through delivery â no waiting for approvals or handing off to another team.

• Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process 

• Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.

• Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your technical leadership experience, how you approach ownership of a service area, and team dynamics.

• Technical / Coding Challenge - A hands-on coding exercise to assess your problem-solving approach, code quality, and comfort working in the stack.

• Possible In-Person Interview - Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.

• Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.

• Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

title: Program Administration Manager
description:
Campaigns

• Full Time
• Remote / Occasional Travel
• Salary $75,000 - $100,000

Organization Overview

Greenlight America is the leading grassroots campaign force powering the nation's clean energy transition at the local level. Our team supports local residents and organizations working to get clean energy built in their communities. Since our founding in 2023, we have enabled volunteers to advance thousands of megawatts' worth of utility-scale projects across the country, helping hundreds of communities to say yes to the benefits of a clean energy future.

Position Overview

Greenlight America is hiring a Program Administration Manager to help lead program administration and operations for our growing campaigns department.

The Program Administration Manager supports the Senior Director of Campaigns in running a growing department. They build department-wide systems, support internal communications, and lead special projects, while also managing core operational functions and providing executive support to the Senior Director. Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. The successful candidate will be a highly organized, proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative to build better systems, and brings strong professional judgment. They will genuinely enjoy working as part of a team and build trust easily across people and functions. The Program Administration Manager reports to the Senior Director of Campaigns.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Program Administration â 50%

• Design and improve department-wide systems and structures, working closely with the Senior Director to identify gaps and build practical, scalable solutions.
• Serve as the lead for the department retreat and other all-team convenings, from logistics through content flow.
• Design onboarding, structure, and support systems for a new department internship/fellowship program.
• Establish and maintain a regular department communication cadence (e.g. weekly updates, department call recaps), including best practices and norms for internal comms.
• Draft and/or coordinate internal communications on behalf of the Senior Director, including the weekly department update.
• Maintain organized department files, shared resources, and documentation so the team can work efficiently.
• Support culture and engagement efforts for the department, in partnership with the Senior Director.
• Provide light-touch executive support to the Senior Director, including coordinating travel logistics and arranging team gestures for staff.
• Take on ad hoc special projects at the Senior Director's direction as departmental needs evolve.

Campaign Operations Management â 50%

• Coordinate with Ops on the campaigns department's budget management, including designing better systems for tracking expenditures, flagging variances, and working with staff and finance to keep spending on track.
• Identify gaps in departmental operations systems and processes and develop practical solutions that scale with the team's growth.
• Manage campaign operational workflows such as contractor invoicing and train campaign staff on those workflows.
• Build and maintain campaign systems for accurate expense categorization, ensuring campaign staff understand and follow financial protocols.
• Proactively coordinate work across campaign staff, operations staff, and other key stakeholders using clear, direct, and thoughtful communication.
• Drive adoption of financial and operational practices through effective communication, rollout, and follow-up.
• Serve as a responsive point of contact for campaign staff, contractors, and others, addressing operational questions with a caring, helpful approach.
• Support onboarding coordination for new campaigns department hires.

Experience And Qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates with the following qualifications:

• 3+ years of relevant program administration or operations experience, ideally in a nonprofit, campaign, or mission-driven environment.
• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of building and implementing systems and processes. Familiarity with project management and automation tools (e.g. Asana, Zapier) is a plus.
• Experience rolling out new processes and driving adoption with a team, including situations without direct management authority.
• Experience with budget management and financial tracking; comfort working with spreadsheets and financial data.
• Experience working with a senior leader to translate department priorities and goals into action.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting communications on behalf of senior leaders.
• Comfort and experience building relationships, communicating, and coordinating work with staff across an organization, including leadership and staff outside the assigned department.
• Demonstrated ability to act as a responsive point of contact to field incoming questions, support problem-solving, and resolve issues in a way that builds trust.
• Exercises discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.
• Excitement for taking systems built in a fast-growing organization and bringing them to the next level of maturity and sophistication; comfortable identifying problems and building solutions from scratch.
• Proactive, self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Comfort in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built and flexibility is required.
• Passion for accelerating the clean energy transition.

Compensation And Benefits

The base annual salary for this position is $75,000-$100,000. We offer an excellent benefits package which includes 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, monthly technology stipend, and retirement contributions through 401k and Roth plans.

• Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. If you require accommodations so that you may participate in the selection process, please email accommodations@greenlightamerica.org.

Due to the volume of applicants, we will only contact applicants whose skill sets and experience meet our needs.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

Weâre backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. About the Role:

As an Intern Machine Learning Engineer on a 6-month contract, you will help build, test, and deploy ML-powered services on our provider data platform. This is not a pure research role; the focus is on strong software engineering, testing, and robust evaluation rather than novel model architectures.

You will own features end-to-end by collaborating with stakeholders, implementing production-ready code, designing evaluation pipelines, and deploying services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a fully remote position.

Build and maintain evaluation pipelines and metrics to measure model and system performance in production-like environments.

Deploy and operate ML services on GCP, including tools such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage.

Troubleshoot and improve existing ML services with a focus on reliability, latency, and correctness.

What Youâll Need:

Experience as a Software Engineer or Machine Learning Engineer.

Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production services.

Hands-on experience deploying and running workloads on Google Cloud Platform.

Expertise in writing and debugging SQL queries.

Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including testing, debugging, version control (Git), CI/CD, and monitoring.

Experience evaluating ML systems by defining metrics, building evaluation datasets, running experiments, and interpreting results.

Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive projects with limited supervision.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Comfort proactively reaching out to internal stakeholders to understand requirements.

Bonus Points If You:

Have experience writing code in Java.

Have built or maintained data pipelines or ETL jobs on GCP.

Have experience working with healthcare data, compliance requirements, or PII.

Have used experiment tracking and evaluation tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or custom dashboards.

title: Regional General Manager Airports
description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

• Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
• Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
• Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
• Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
• Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
• Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
• Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
• Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
• Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
• Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives. 

Experience And Qualifications

• 3+ years Airports leadership experience required 
• Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships. 
• Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget. 
• Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities. 
• Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels. 
• Post-secondary education with a business application an asset. 
• Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously. 
• Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook. 
• Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time. 
• Project management skills considered an asset. 
• Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset. 
• Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams. 
• IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial. 

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

• A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
• Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
• Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isnât the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.
